record_room.name: Record Room
record_room.description: A synthesis face, 2.10 m of it: a chart recorder with four lanes stacked one above the other, ALL FED FROM ONE TIME AXIS, each holding the SAME single measured signal under a different regime of keeping. instant has no paper at all — a well, a scale ladder and a live pen, so it can only say where the reading is now. window has paper inked over the newest 11 of 48 ticks and blank before them. archive is inked end to end with the run-out folded at the old end. margin is the archive READ: printed rules, a limit rail at 0.739 of full scale, a tick scale along the foot, and a hand's ring round the largest excursion. Because the four lanes share one time axis, window's ink sits directly under the right-hand fifth of archive's ink at the same x and the same scale, so the claim that a window is a truncation of an archive is read off the alignment instead of taken on trust. Every mark in all four lanes comes from one signal computed once at build time. Nothing here moves, nothing here is random, and the artifact has no per-frame code at all.
interactions: read the face downward from instant to margin and notice the pen never moves
read it across: window's ink is the right-hand fifth of archive's ink, at the same x
ask each lane a different question and find the one lane that cannot answer any of them
record_room.capacity: SEE that the four values of `record` are a ladder in how much is KEPT and not a ladder in what can be ASKED — the fourth rung keeps exactly what the third keeps and adds a reader instead of a measurement
record_room.qfep_connection: F is the signal: one rule, evaluated once, identical in every lane, which is why the face is a comparison and not four drawings. E is the four records, and they are NOT irreducible to each other — unusually for this project they strictly nest, and that nesting is the finding rather than an embarrassment, because what nests is the ink and what does not nest is the set of questions the ink will answer. lambda is how much of what happened the instrument is built to still be holding when somebody walks up to it. The dark spot is `instant`: a lane with a live pen, a lit scale and no paper photographs as a working instrument, and it carries 0.9% of everything on this face that depends on what is being measured.
record_room.relationships:
Synthesised out of the six artifacts that declare a `record` axis. Five are instruments and share the value list character for character; the sixth asks a different question under the same word and is named as an outlier in dna.kin.

[[seismograph]] is the family's plainest case and the source of `event`. Its detector draws noise in [-0.1, 0.1] every 0.1 s and, on a hit, a baseline that a tween walks linearly to zero over 3.0 s; the room takes that noise band exactly, its decay proportion (30 of 96 ticks, so 15 of 48) and its rate (one event per 24 ticks, so two on a 48-tick chart). Its truth statement is the one this whole room is built to make checkable: 'an instrument that keeps nothing can never be contradicted. The paper is what makes it answerable.'

[[multimeter]] is the source of `cycle`, of `steady` and of `drift`, because it is the one member with four selectable modes and therefore the one member that already contains a census. Mode 0 is a sine at 2.88 periods across its own tape; modes 1 and 3 are constants under noise so small it cannot be drawn; mode 2 is a slow arc. Its window fraction, 11 of 48 dots, is this room's window fraction.

[[atmosphericmonitoring]] is the reason the four lanes share one time axis. It already stacks three channels on one card and says why a shared amplitude axis would be wrong for them — 'a shared axis would flatten a 0.5 degree swing against a 5 hPa one and draw three straight lines' — and this room does the opposite deliberately, because its four lanes are not three channels but one channel kept four ways, and a per-lane ceiling would be exactly the frame-relative normalisation that is forbidden. Its three frequencies (0.05, 0.02, 0.03 Hz over a 120 s span) supply three of the four periods-per-chart the `cycle` value's 3.0 is the median of.

[[holographicdisplay]] is the member with no paper: it keeps its record in the same medium it displays in, light, as a wake of three poses or a shell of twelve. It contributes the fourth window fraction to the census (3 of 12) and it is the proof that the family's word is about RETENTION and not about paper.

[[dual_display_test]] is the sharpest form of the question — a screen has no needle to leave a mark and no paper to leave it on, so its record has to be a physically separate object, a printout pinned to a board. It is counted as `steady` because it draws WaveformDisplay's no-audio signal, 'the one thing on this rig that is defined when the room is silent'.

[[harmonic_motion_demo]] declares `record` and is NOT a source. See dna.kin.

Structurally this is [[evidence_ladder]]'s rule: one phenomenon evaluated ONCE at build time and drawn N ways side by side, so nothing on the bench can disagree with anything else on it. It is the third room in the sequence [[retention_corridor]] (what a MARK keeps) and [[removal_room]] (what a CUT leaves), and it differs from both in what the question is FOR. A mark's retention decides what survives; an instrument's retention decides which questions may be put to it. The corridor and the room are about the past; this face is about what you are allowed to ask.

measurements.measured_from: source geometry, not a capture — the constants were read back out of record_room.gd by script. Plinth 2.18 wide (CASE_W + 0.08) x 0.18 tall; case 2.10 x 1.68; header rail 2.10 x 0.10; cornice 2.16 x 0.04. Height 0.00 to CASE_Y1 + HEAD_H + CORN_H = 2.00. Depth from the cornice back face -0.155 to the plinth front +0.140 = 0.295.

dna.default:
behaviour=event. A synthesis has no shipped placements, so the default is a free design choice with no preservation duty, and this is the STRONGEST single reading rather than the commonest one.

THE CENSUS AND THE CHOICE DISAGREE, and the disagreement is stated rather than smoothed. `cycle` is the family's commonest signal by a wide margin — five of the ten channels its six members evaluate — and `event` is one. retention_corridor defaulted to its own commonest value for exactly that reason. This room does not, because the two criteria that agreed there conflict here.

THE JUSTIFICATION IS COUNTABLE. Give each lane the question it can answer and read off its answer: instant answers with the pen height at the newest tick, window with the range over the newest 11 ticks, archive with the range over all 48, margin with whether the largest excursion crossed the printed rail at 0.739 of full scale. Then

  event    0.1311 | 0.6424 | 0.8982 | CROSSED   — four different answers
  cycle    0.0000 | 0.8815 | 0.9994 | not       — three
  drift    0.4187 | 0.1731 | 0.8374 | not       — three
  steady   0.0000 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | not       — ONE, given four ways

`event` is the unique maximum and the only value at which all four rungs differ in kind: the pen sits near the quiet baseline and the instrument looks fine, the window shows a large monotone decline from 0.728 to 0.208 with no cause visible, the archive shows the two onsets that caused it, and the margin shows that the larger one went past a limit somebody printed before the measurement was taken. It is also the value that exposes the family's own thumb on the scale (see dna.note).

`steady` is the honest null of the whole axis and is deliberately kept as a value: at a signal that does nothing, the four rungs are indistinguishable in what they say, and an axis that cannot produce its own null is an axis that cannot be disbelieved.

NO PRESERVATION QUESTION ARISES. This artifact did not exist before this pass and has zero placements, so there is no shipped behaviour for a default to preserve. The rule that outranks everything in doc/DNA_PROMOTION_BRIEF.md is about promotions of placed artifacts; here it has no work to do.
dna.was: synthesized from the six artifacts that declare `record` (measured, not assumed: a sweep of every registry file returns exactly six declaring entries, five sharing instant|window|archive|margin and one carrying both|trace|prediction|bare). Nothing was promoted here — this artifact did not exist.
dna.law_2:
NEST OR SIDE BY SIDE — answered MIXED, from the members' CODE and not their prose, and the answer decided the shape of the room.

BY EXTENT the four values NEST, strictly and by construction. All five instrument members run the identical shape in _build_record: full = record != "window"; draw the carrier; if margin, print the furniture; draw `count` strokes where count is ALL or WINDOW; if full, draw the run-out; if margin, ring the peak. The window's strokes are a PREFIX of the archive's — same array, same step, same first index — so drawn(instant) = the empty set, a subset of drawn(window), a subset of drawn(archive), a subset of drawn(margin). seismograph's header says so in words: 'Monotone, like prng_crank_machine's disclosure ladder: each rung carries everything the rung below it carries plus one more kind of account.'

BY CLAIM it is mixed at ONE joint. Rungs 1-3 differ in how much of the PAST is kept — 0, then 11 of 48, then 48 of 48. Rung 4 keeps exactly what rung 3 keeps and adds a SECOND AUTHOR: rules and a limit rail that were printed before any measurement was taken, and a ring drawn by somebody who came back to the chart afterwards. Three rungs nest along one dimension and the fourth adds a parallel apparatus on top of the last.

AND THE ROOM MEASURES ITS OWN ANSWER, which is the part no member could have done. Rasterised at the sweep's own geometry and attributed per lane by an id-buffer, the share of everything that changes when the signal changes is instant 0.9%, window 13.4%, archive 42.3%, margin 43.4%, shell 0.0%. Archive and margin are within 1.1 points of each other and draw the same 47 segments. So the fourth rung's entire apparatus of reading is worth about one point of information about what is being measured — the arithmetic form of 'margin adds a reader, not a measurement'.

WHY SIDE BY SIDE ANYWAY, despite the nesting. Law 2 says a nesting family wants its own word varied. That ruling is right when the row would be redundant, and here the nesting is the exact thing a row can show and a single instrument cannot: because the window's ink is a prefix of the archive's, four lanes sharing ONE time axis put the truncation directly underneath the whole, at the same x and the same scale. The nesting becomes a vertical alignment a visitor can check rather than a claim in a caption. Varying `record` would demolish three of four lanes and photograph the ladder being dismantled, which is retention_corridor's and removal_room's ruling and transfers without modification.
dna.brief_correction:
THE COMMISSION'S READING OF `margin` IS FALSIFIED BY THE FAMILY'S CODE, and this is reported rather than quietly built around.

This room was commissioned with the argument that `margin` 'keeps not the readings but the BOUNDS — the highest and lowest ever seen — which is the least data and answers HAS THIS EVER BEEN WORSE.' That is a good idea and it is not what any member implements. In all five instruments `margin` draws the FULL archive and adds to it; there is no branch anywhere in the family in which margin keeps less than archive. Checked line by line: seismograph._build_record sets full = record != "window", so margin takes the full-stroke path and then calls _rec_furniture and _rec_hand on top; multimeter, atmosphericmonitoring, holographicdisplay and dual_display_test are the same construction.

The bounds idea IS present in the family, twice — every member's _rec_hand rings the argmax of |sample| and every member's _rec_furniture prints a limit rail — but as an ANNOTATION ON a complete archive, never instead of one. So the room builds what the code does. A synthesis that exhibits a family word is worth something only if it exhibits the word the family actually means, and the difference is not cosmetic: under the commission's reading margin would keep the LEAST data of any rung and the ladder would turn round at the end, which is a far more interesting shape than the one the corpus contains. It would also have been a fact about a brief.
dna.note:
WHAT THE FACE ARGUES, and no member can. Read down the column the row is monotone in ink: nothing, a fifth, all of it, all of it with marks on. Read for what can be ASKED and it stops being monotone at the last rung. `margin` keeps exactly what `archive` keeps — the same 47 segments, from the same array — and everything it adds was either printed before the measurement (the rules, the tick scale, the limit rail) or added after it by somebody else (the ring, the bracket). Measured: archive carries 42.3% of everything that changes with the signal, margin 43.4%. A whole extra apparatus, worth 1.1 points. That is not a criticism of the fourth rung; it is what the fourth rung IS. It does not tell you more about the world. It tells you that somebody has been at the chart.

THE SECOND FINDING IS AT THE TOP OF THE FACE. The `instant` lane carries 0.9% of all the change. It has a live pen, a lit scale ladder and a well, and it photographs as a working instrument at every value of the axis, because it is one. What it cannot do is tell you which of four completely different signals it is attached to. And at two of the four values it cannot tell them apart AT ALL: at `cycle` the newest tick lands at 0.5*sin(3*TAU) = 0 exactly, and at `steady` it is 0 by construction, so the top lane is byte-identical between a three-period sine and a dead flat line. That identity is predicted, exact, and is the whole thesis of the room rendered as a measurement rather than a caption.

THE THIRD FINDING IS ABOUT THE FAMILY, not about this room. seismograph._record_samples walks index 0 = NEWEST — its own comment says 'the pen sits at the LEFT end ... index 0 is the freshest sample and the ink grows away from the pen' — and applies each event's decay with `if i >= at and i - at <= REC_DECAY_TICKS`, i.e. over indices at .. at+30, which in that indexing is the thirty ticks BEFORE the onset. Its detector does the opposite: detect_seismic_activity sets a baseline and a tween walks it to zero over the FOLLOWING 3.0 s. So on that instrument's paper every event's sharp attack faces the pen and its slow decay runs backwards into the past. It is one comparison operator, it is invisible unless you replay the chart, and this room draws the decay forward in time and says so rather than inheriting it.

AND A COINCIDENCE DECLARED RATHER THAN HIDDEN. The window opens at tick 37 (48 - 11) and the newer event's onset lands at tick 36 (3/4 of 48). Those numbers come from independent family constants — 11/48 is the window fraction multimeter and seismograph share to five decimal places, and one event per 24 ticks is seismograph's rate — and nothing was placed to arrange the gap. The consequence is the room's sharpest picture, a window showing a large decline with no cause in it. It is flagged because seismograph's own header admits to arranging the opposite deliberately: 'the event TIMES are fixed rather than rolled so the picture is reproducible across sweeps and so the `window` rung (the first 22 samples) is guaranteed to contain one.' A family that has already once put its thumb on this exact scale is a family whose next coincidence should be declared.
dna.kin:
`record` IS REFUSED AS THIS ARTIFACT'S AXIS, on the record, and the refusal is the design. Each of the five instrument members uses the word to stand in ONE regime and forgo the other three; on this face all four stand at once and that simultaneity IS the object. An axis whose every value demolishes three quarters of the exhibit is not a variation of it. That is retention_corridor's ruling on `retention` and removal_room's on `removal`. The word is EXHIBITED instead — it names the artifact and it names the four lanes, engraved beside each one — and what turns is the signal underneath.

THERE IS NO ORIGIN MEMBER, which is unusual in this corpus and was checked rather than assumed. `git log -S` on the export line returns the SAME commit for all five instruments (4e3bb2a63, 2026-08-01, 'the wavefunctions tier'), and seismograph.gd was created by that commit. `retention` has mystic_writing_pad and `removal` has cantor_set; `record` has five simultaneous births and no parent, so there is no member const to defer to and none of the five exposes its list as a named constant at all. The room's vocabulary check therefore reads the @export_enum hint out of ALL FIVE members' scripts at _ready, via a Script-typed local so the call is an instance call rather than the non-static trap, and compares each against its own list in BOTH directions. That is stronger than deferring to one owner: it also catches two members drifting apart from each other, which no per-artifact gate would see.

[[harmonic_motion_demo]] DECLARES `record` AND IS NOT A SOURCE. It carries both|trace|prediction|bare and its own comment says what those mean: 'what evidence the bench keeps on screen', where `prediction` is the ideal sine drawn ahead of the bead and `trace` is the path already walked. That is a question about what a PHYSICS DEMO overlays on a motion — promise against outcome — not about how much of the past an instrument is still holding. Its four values do not nest, its `bare` is not this family's `instant` (it removes the drawn evidence and keeps four numbers on a readout), and it is the one member of the six with a named const for its values. It is counted in the census as an outlier and its signal is not a value on this axis.

`behaviour` IS THIS ARTIFACT'S OWN WORD and no sibling declares it (checked against all 465 declared axis words). Two candidates were refused. `signal` was the first choice and is IMPOSSIBLE: signal is a GDScript keyword and cannot be a variable name, so the export would not have parsed. `waveform` is UNAVAILABLE: [[additive_wave_demo]], [[fourier_transform]] and [[timbre_sculptor]] all declare it meaning an oscillator's shape (sine | square | sawtooth | triangle), and adding a third meaning to a live word is the dishonest half of a shared vocabulary. `behaviour` is also the standard instrumentation taxonomy — steady state, oscillation, drift, transient — which is, exactly, what the family's own code turns out to contain.

THE VALUE LIST IS THE FAMILY'S OWN CENSUS OF SIGNALS, derived and not invented. All six members were read and every signal their code evaluates was counted. Ten channels: cycle 5 (multimeter mode 0; atmosphericmonitoring pressure 0.05 Hz, temperature 0.02 Hz, humidity 0.03 Hz; holographicdisplay's turn), steady 3 (multimeter mode 1 DC and mode 3 FREQUENCY; dual_display_test's silent-room spectrum), event 1 (seismograph), drift 1 (multimeter mode 2 RESISTANCE). 5 + 3 + 1 + 1 = 10. The list partitions the family's signals exactly; nothing is left out and nothing is added.

DECLARED ORDER: event, cycle, drift, steady. build_dna_gallery trims value lists from the TAIL, so the default goes first and one member of the predicted closest pair goes last. The closest pair is event/steady, so `steady` is last and a run capped at three keeps event, cycle, drift and never grades the pair most at risk of reading alike. `cycle` is second because it is the family's commonest signal, five of ten channels, so a capped sweep keeps the two values most of the corpus actually measures.
dna.one_ceiling:
LAW 5, AND THE ONE PLACE THIS ROOM DELIBERATELY CONTRADICTS A MEMBER. All four behaviours are drawn against ONE full scale — +/-1.0 deflection maps to +/-0.15 m, in every lane, at every value. [[atmosphericmonitoring]] normalises each of its three channels to its own lane instead and says why: 'a shared axis would flatten a 0.5 degree swing against a 5 hPa one and draw three straight lines.' That is right for three simultaneous channels on one card and wrong here, because these four lanes are not three channels but one channel kept four ways. A per-value ceiling would make `steady` undefined (its range is exactly zero, so there is nothing to normalise to) and would draw `drift` and `cycle` at the same height, which is precisely the frame-relative normalisation law 5 forbids. The ceiling is fixed and `steady` is allowed to be a flat line, because a steady signal is a flat line.

THE ONE AMPLITUDE THE ROOM WOULD NOT COPY IS DRIFT'S, and the arithmetic is why. multimeter mode 2 reads 1000 + 50*sin(0.3 t) ohms and maps it to the needle with clamp(log(r)/10, 0, 1)*2 - 1. Because d(log r) = dr/r, a +/-5% swing in resistance becomes +/-0.05/10*2 = +/-0.01 of full-scale deflection — ONE PERCENT — and its noise term (randf*10 on 1000) adds another +/-0.002. The family's own drift member, replayed onto its own tape, draws a straight line 0.38 of the way up. Copying its amplitude would have made `drift` a second `steady` at a different height, two of four values photographing as one line, and the log mapping rather than the design would have been the finding. The SHAPE is taken exactly — a monotone arc over a phase window of 0.864 rad, which is that mode's own 0.3 rad/s across its own 2.88 s tape — and only the amplitude is gauged to this room's full scale. It is the only number in the artifact that is not the family's, and it is named here so nobody has to find it.

predicted_degeneracy.currency: the critic's own: crop to the subject bbox, take the absolute difference from the corner pixel, greyscale, area-average to 160x160, abs diff, mean of the hottest 5% (1280 of 25600 samples).
predicted_degeneracy.why: `event` and `steady` are the same picture wherever nothing is happening. `event` is two decaying envelopes on a +/-0.10 noise floor; outside the envelopes its trace wanders +/-0.10 of full scale = +/-0.015 m = +/-3.67 px against a 6.85 px pen, so two pen strokes whose centres differ by the mean |noise| of 1.835 px still overlap over (6.85 - 1.835)/6.85 = 73.2% of their height. Counted exactly: the two envelopes (onsets 12 and 36, decay 15) raise ticks 12..27 and 36..47, so 20 of the 48 ticks are quiet (0..11 and 28..35) and 18 of the 47 DRAWN SEGMENTS — 38.3% — span two quiet ticks and are ~73% identical between the two values. The `instant` lane adds almost nothing to the separation: a pen carriage 0.034 m = 8.32 px tall sitting at 0.1311 of full scale against one at 0.0000 is a 4.81 px shift, so even there the two overlap by 42%. The pair at the other end is event/cycle at 35.435%, because a three-period sine and two spikes share almost no columns at all.
predicted_degeneracy.exact_zero_predicted: A SUB-REGION PREDICTED AT EXACTLY 0.000%. At `cycle` the newest tick is 0.5*sin(3*TAU) = 0 and at `steady` it is 0 by construction, so the `instant` lane — well, scale ladder and pen carriage — is byte-identical between those two values. Measured 0.000% on that lane's pixels. If the sweep shows any difference there, the pen is not reading _pass[N_TICK-1].
predicted_degeneracy.gate: THE NUMBER IS A FLOOR AND THE FLOOR IS 15.633%, NOT 26.443%. The four historical predictions in doc/DNA_PROMOTION_BRIEF.md each under-predicted by 1.5x to 6.7x because a Python rasteriser has one directional light, flat shading and no shadows, AO or antialiasing. Those multipliers should NOT be expected here and it would be dishonest to quote them: this room is black ink on white paper filling three lanes, so its contrast is near the maximum available and there is far less for a real renderer to add. The prediction was therefore run across 8 models — the critic's two measured capture backgrounds, (148,174,149) and (130,165,118), crossed with ambient terms 0.15, 0.34, 0.55 and 0.75 — and event/steady was the closest pair in ALL EIGHT, ranging 15.633% to 26.443%. 26.443% is the reference model (the brighter measured background, ambient 0.34). IF THE SWEEP COMES BACK BELOW 15.633%, SOMETHING IS BROKEN and the first thing to check is whether the trace is drawing at all.

dna.framing_why:
ARITHMETIC, NOT TASTE, computed from constants read back out of the script. Union mesh AABB 2.18 x 2.00 x 0.295 (plinth 2.18 wide, cornice 2.16, height 0.00 to 2.00, depth -0.155 to +0.140), diagonal sqrt(4.7524 + 4.0 + 0.087025) = 2.973117, radius 1.486559.

capture_config_sweep fits by DIAGONAL: dist = radius / tan(FOV/2) * PAD * framing, with FOV 34 and PAD 1.9, so tan(17 deg) = 0.3057307. At framing 1.0 the camera stands 9.238496 m out, the visible frame is 5.648922 m across, the case projects cos(0.62)*2.18 + sin(0.62)*0.295 = 1.945659 m or 34.4% of it, and ONE LANE'S FULL-SCALE BAND is 0.30 m or 5.3% of frame height — the dilution floor exactly.

At 0.55 the camera comes to 5.081173 m and the frame to 3.106907 m. The case projects to 62.6% of frame width and 2.00*cos(0.26) + 0.295*sin(0.26) = 2.008619 m or 64.6% of its height; the subject bbox is 60.9% x 75.1% and the subject itself measures 24.33% of frame. That is the number every mark in the artifact was sized against: 760 / 3.106907 = 244.616 px per metre, giving a 6.85 px pen, a 7.81 px sample step, a 36.69 px full scale, a 4.40 px limit rail, a 3.91 px foot tick and a 5.87 px ring bead, none of them inside the 1-3 px band law 4 exists because of.

The title is engraved on the header rail rather than floated above the cornice, so nothing this artifact draws sits outside the mesh extent and a tighter framing cannot crop a label. 0.50 is available (269.08 px/m, case 68.9% of frame width) if a later pass wants the marks bigger; it was not taken because 0.55 is what [[retention_corridor]] and [[removal_room]] were framed at and the three rooms should be comparable at a glance.
dna.still_note:
WHAT SHOULD BITE AND WHAT SHOULD NOT, said in advance so a number is read correctly rather than filed.

THE `instant` LANE IS NEARLY IDENTICAL AT EVERY VALUE by construction, and that is the design rather than a fault. It carries a measured 0.9% of all the change on this face; only the pen carriage moves, by at most 0.4187 of full scale = 15.4 px. A quarter of the exhibit that barely moves is the same situation as evidence_ladder's first pier and retention_corridor's empty bay, and here it is the argument: an instrument that keeps nothing is 1% informative about what it is attached to.

WHERE THE CHANGE ACTUALLY LANDS, measured by id-buffer over all six pairs: instant 0.9%, window 13.4%, archive 42.3%, margin 43.4%, shell 0.0%. Two things to read from that. First, window carries 31.7% of archive's change while drawing 21.3% of its segments (10 of 47) — it over-performs its sample count because the newest end of the chart is where the four behaviours differ most, which is a fact about these four signals and not a general law. Second, the shell contributes 0.0% to two decimal places: the case, the plinth, the header, the cornice, the wells, the scale ladders, the run-outs, the printed rules, the rails, the tick scales and all five labels are identical at every value, so every pixel that moves across this axis is a mark the signal made.

STRONGEST AND WEAKEST PAIRS are in dna.predicted_degeneracy with their arithmetic. Strongest event/cycle at 35.435%; weakest event/steady at 26.443% with a floor of 15.633%.

THE PEN IS DELIBERATELY FAT, and this is the one place legibility was bought with fidelity. 6.85 px on a 36.69 px full scale is 18.7% of the scale and no real chart pen is. At the family's own line weights (seismograph draws 0.005 m bars) the trace here would be 1.22 px and the axis would sink into the noise floor the bite critic measures against. The cost is paid where the closest pair is: `steady`'s zero-amplitude noise and `event`'s +/-0.10 quiet band both sit INSIDE one pen width, so those two traces overlap wherever nothing is happening. That is a true fact about a chart at this line weight and it is why the two are the predicted twins.

THE CAPTURE AABB IS THE REAL BODY and no layers = 0 anchor is needed. The trace and the hand's ring are MultiMesh, but every instance sits inside a lane and every lane sits inside a case built entirely from MeshInstance3D boxes, so the mesh extent already bounds them. The five Label3D are not counted by the AABB, and all five lie on the case's own front face, so they can neither move the camera nor crop.

IF IT COMES BACK FAINT, check the harness before the design. This is a 2.18 x 2.00 face with a 0.295 m depth — close to square, which is the good case for a 760x760 frame — so the wide-flat hazard does not apply. If a sweep is run --staged, a 2.00 m floor-standing case does not want a plinth under it and the pair AABB will grow; measure unstaged.
declines: `record` AS THIS ARTIFACT'S AXIS — refused, see dna.kin. It would bite enormously, because three quarters of the ink would change between values, and that is most of what is wrong with it: the face's entire claim is that the four regimes stand at once on ONE time axis so the nesting can be seen as an alignment. The large number it would produce would be a measurement of the exhibit being dismantled.

`waveform` AS THE AXIS WORD — refused because three artifacts already declare it meaning an oscillator's shape. `signal` — refused because it is a GDScript keyword and will not parse as a variable name.

A SECOND AXIS ON THE WINDOW FRACTION — the length of the window, swept from a few ticks to nearly the whole chart. It is real, it is still-visible, and it is declined because the family's four members agree on that number to within 2 percentage points (11/48, 22/96, 19/78, 3/12 — 0.229, 0.229, 0.244, 0.250). An axis whose whole range is narrower than the corpus's own agreement is an axis about nothing, and widening it past what any member does would be inventing a disagreement to have something to sweep.

A TIME AXIS — the chart speed, the pen response, the sample interval, the fade of an old trace. These are the knobs the members themselves are built out of and every one of them is invisible to a still. The room's answer is not to declare them but to put the SPAN on a spatial axis, which is what a chart recorder was always for and is the one thing about time a photograph can hold.

A LIVE PEN — an instrument actually writing into the face while you watch. Declined for the reason two members of the `retention` family already found independently and reported against their own interest: with nothing driving the input, every sample lands on the same value and the record degenerates to a figure identical at every value of the axis. This face draws the STANDING record and says so, rather than shipping a lane that is flat for a reason the photograph cannot show.

INSTANCING THE SOURCE SCENES — a seismograph, a multimeter, a weather station and a hologram standing in the four lanes. Refused because the sources are live machines with _process loops, timers, tweens, viewports, audio buses and OmniLight3D nodes; four of them in one scene would be four rooms in a trench coat, and their live traces would each be the degenerate figure declined above. What the face needs from them is their CLAIM and their NUMBERS, so the noise band, the decay proportion, the event rate, the event magnitudes, the window fraction, the limit-rail position, the periods-per-chart and all five colours are taken from the source files exactly, and nothing else is.

A `bounds` VALUE ON `record`, i.e. building the commission's reading as a fifth lane. Refused because no member implements it and adding a value to a family's live word is exactly what tools/check_dna_declarations.py exists to catch one level down. It is recorded in dna.brief_correction as a better shape than the corpus contains, so that whoever wants it changes the five members first and this face second.
dna.fixture_note:
NO FIXTURE AND NO SEED PARAMETER, and the absence is checkable rather than claimed: there is no randf, randi or randomize in the file, no _process, no _physics_process, no timer, no tween, and no reference to the scene tree outside this artifact's own children. _ready is ungated and builds the whole face standalone, so nothing has to be supplied for the still, and a capture's settle time cannot photograph this artifact half way through anything.

THE ONE STOCHASTIC TERM IS `event`'s NOISE, and it comes from a seeded linear congruential generator written out in the file — s = (1103515245*s + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF, seed 7132026, drawn once per tick in index order — rather than from RandomNumberGenerator as the members do. Both are deterministic inside Godot; only this one is reproducible in Python, which is why the closest-pair prediction above is an exact statement about the tile that will be captured rather than a statement about a distribution.
dna.budget_note:
67 MeshInstance3D exactly — 4 of case (plinth, body, header rail, cornice), 9 per lane in all four lanes (well, five scale ticks, scale spine, pen carriage, pen mark) = 36, 3 paper strips, 15 of printed furniture on `margin` (3 rules across, 5 rules down, 5 foot ticks, 2 limit rails), 6 run-out leaves across `archive` and `margin`, and 3 of the hand's bracket. Plus 4 MultiMeshInstance3D — three trace clouds carrying 10 + 47 + 47 = 104 segment instances and one ring of 20 beads — and 5 Label3D. No collision bodies and no static bodies at all. Three orders of magnitude under the element budget and nowhere near the watchdog.

THE TRACE IS DRAWN AS SPANNING SEGMENTS, NOT AS DOTS AND NOT AS A LINE STRIP. Each segment runs from tick i to tick i+1 and is at least one pen wide, which is seismograph's own construction (its bars span min..max of the two samples with a 0.004 floor) at this room's gauge. A PRIMITIVE_LINE_STRIP would come back a hairline in a 760 px still, and a dot cloud would break a chart recorder's continuous pen into something it is not.
